protocol.selection_metric: validation RMSE on all validation cases
protocol.preprocessing: Ridge/RF median imputer and Ridge scaler fit on training rows only
protocol.seasonal_baseline: exact observed depth at target month one year earlier (origin minus six calendar months)
protocol.origin_policy: Known causal origin GWL may be limited forward-fill; target must be observed.

limitations: The saved bundle and its holdout have already been inspected; this is a reproducibility audit, not a newly blinded trial.
Sparse observed labels and the small set of recent districts cannot establish nationwide current-period accuracy.
Aggregate R2 is influenced by depth differences between districts; consult errors and district metrics.
Historical publication/revision dates and comparable-well panels are unavailable.
No MAPE is reported because targets can be zero or close to zero.
No calibrated prediction intervals are claimed; point forecast evaluation does not establish interval coverage.

saved_monthly_climate.origin_policy: Both origin and target explicitly observed; current estimated anchors and zone fallback are not validated here.

validation.weather_policy: Historical same-month weather means available at each origin, not realized future weather.
validation.groundwater_origin_policy: Observed origins; this does not validate estimated current levels after multi-year gaps.

test.weather_policy: Historical same-month weather means available at each origin, not realized future weather.
test.groundwater_origin_policy: Observed origins; this does not validate estimated current levels after multi-year gaps.
